label: 蒙皮 QC
description: 角色骨架/蒙皮的静态质量检查（只读）：skeleton/root 有效、bone 父链无环、骨长非零、skin 引用有效、可蒙皮网格来源存在；可选接收前端体素测地绑定求解后的 unreachable 诊断并打非致命警告。权重和=1/无零权重等纯数值校验仍放前端求解后做。输出 valid + report + 结构化 signals，几何透传。
description-en: Static QC for character skeleton/skin (read-only): valid skeleton/root, acyclic bone parents, non-zero bone length, valid skin refs, skinnable-mesh source present; optionally accepts post-solve voxel geodesic binding "unreachable" diagnostics and emits a non-fatal warning. Purely numeric weight checks (sum=1, no zero-weight vertex) still happen on the frontend after solving. Emits valid + report + structured signals; geometry passes through.

inputs.name: geometry
inputs.label: 几何
inputs.description: 含 bone/skeleton/skin 的角色几何

inputs.name: weight_diagnostics
inputs.label: 权重诊断（可选）
inputs.description: 前端 computeSkinWeightsVoxel 求解后的诊断，object 或 JSON 字符串：{unreachableVertexCount, unreachableBoneNames}。DSL 编译期没有三角面数据算不出来，只有调用方（无头渲染/回归脚本等）显式喂入时才生效；留空则跳过这项检查。
inputs.description-en: Optional post-solve diagnostics from the frontend's computeSkinWeightsVoxel, as an object or JSON string: {unreachableVertexCount, unreachableBoneNames}. Cannot be computed at DSL-compile time (no triangle data yet) — only takes effect when a caller (headless render/regression script, etc.) explicitly supplies it; leave empty to skip this check.

outputs.name: signals
outputs.label: 信号
outputs.description: 结构化 QC 信号列表
